entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. To speak with an agent, please press 1.
Hi, I need to make a return.
Thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is Linda. I can help you with that. Do you have your order number handy?
Yes, it's VF886-015. I bought the VeloBand Cadence Sensor.
Okay, one moment while I pull that up... VF886-015. I see it here. It looks like the delivery was on December 15th.
That sounds about right. So can I return it?

Yes, absolutely. According to our policy, you have up to 90 days to send an item back. It's no problem at all. I've just processed the request and sent a return label to the email address on file. Is that correct?
Oh, great! That was easy. Yes, that's the right email. So I just print that out and stick it on the box?

That's exactly right. Just drop it off at any postal service location. Once we receive it, the refund will be processed back to your original payment method. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
Nope, that's everything. Thank you, Linda.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit and have a wonderful day.
